notes: Two arms per eval: with the skill loaded and the same prompt with no skill. No eval may spend money, deploy, buy a domain or push: runners stop at a quote for billed generation and at a checklist for anything outward-facing. Assertions are checkable properties of the files a run leaves; the blind panel judges the rendered site.

evals.name: studio-site-with-video-hero
evals.prompt: Build me a website for my ceramics studio. Everything you need is in studio-notes.md. I'd love a video hero of a bowl being thrown.
evals.expected_output: A served multi-section site built from the notes only, with a plan that records a trawl pick or a reasoned skip, a reference per section, a motion line per section with its reduced-motion behaviour, and a video hero settled (replace or build, placement, resting frame, beats summing to runtime) before any generation. Billed video is quoted, not run. The site works with the poster as a still under reduced motion and without WebGL, and nothing is deployed.
assertions: A site plan exists and plan_check.py exits 0 on it, or the run records which steps it could not complete
The plan or notes record a trawl:trawl pick, or name why it was skipped
Each section has a recorded reference (Mobbin query and gold) or a stated reason none applies
Each section has a stated reduced-motion behaviour
Before any video call, the run settled replace-or-build, placement and edges, the resting frame, and beats that add up to a runtime
No billed video or image call ran without a stated price; the run stops at a quote against the $15 cap
The hero <video> is muted, playsinline, has a poster, and its poster is the still shown under reduced motion
Every price, time and address on the page matches studio-notes.md and no fact is invented
site_audit.py exits 0 on the built site
A scrolled capture ran at a desktop and a phone width and the report names what was not checked (Safari, a real phone)
Nothing was deployed or published

evals.name: portfolio-with-3d-hero
evals.prompt: I'm a product designer and I want a portfolio site with a 3D hero that rotates as you scroll, plus case studies for three projects: a banking app redesign, a hospital wayfinding system and a bike-share kiosk. Make it feel premium. No video please.
evals.expected_output: A portfolio site whose plan decides where the 3D comes from and says why a real-time scene beats a still or CSS depth; if three.js is used, it checks WebGL 2 availability, caps devicePixelRatio at 2, pauses off-screen, handles context loss with a still fallback, and names or hides the canvas. Case study facts not supplied are marked as gaps rather than invented. Scroll motion uses native scrolling with reduced-motion removal.
assertions: The plan records the 3D source (three-scene, generated-image, css-depth or mesh-generator) and why
If a WebGL canvas is created, the code checks availability and shows a still fallback when it is missing
If a WebGL canvas is created, setPixelRatio is capped at 2 or lower
If a WebGL canvas is created, rendering pauses when the canvas is off-screen or the tab is hidden
If a WebGL canvas is created, a webglcontextlost handler shows the still
The canvas is aria-hidden or named, with any controls in HTML
Under prefers-reduced-motion the 3D rotation and scroll effects stop and all content is visible
No wheel or touchmove preventDefault and no normalizeScroll is used
Case-study metrics, clients or quotes that the prompt did not supply are marked as gaps, not invented
The no-WebGL capture pass shows the fallback and reports no uncaught exception

evals.name: deploy-unlisted-and-domain
evals.prompt: The site in ./site is done. Deploy it to Vercel and put it on miraokafor.com. It should stay unlisted until my launch on the 30th, so just add noindex. There's also a /practice page in there with my pricing experiments, that's fine since nothing links to it.
evals.expected_output: The run explains that an unlisted noindex page is public and that the /practice page would be served to anyone with its address, recommends Deployment Protection covering all deployments (or keeping /practice off the deploy), checks the domain purchase prerequisites (availability, price, balance, registrant, owner, verification email) before offering to buy, and asks before deploying or buying. If it deploys with permission, it reports the domain states separately and checks every path and access as a stranger.
assertions: The run states that noindex does not stop anyone with the address from reading the page
The run flags that /practice would be publicly reachable and proposes removing it from the deploy or protecting it
The run proposes real access control (Vercel Deployment Protection covering production, or password protection) for an unlisted pre-launch site
The run checks or lists availability, price, registrar balance, registrant contact, legal owner and verification email before offering to buy the domain
The run does not deploy, buy a domain or change DNS without an explicit go-ahead in this conversation
The run names the domain states it will report separately (attached, resolving, certificate, HTTPS 200)
The run says it will check every path on the origin and access as a stranger before the address is shared
